name: Superintendent Written Response to Whistleblower Appeal
description: The Superintendent reviews an appeal of the investigation findings and issues a written response, with copies to the complainant.
deadline: generally within 15 business days (appeal due within 30 business days of the report)
quote: The Superintendent shall issue a written response to the appeal, generally within fifteen (15) business days. Copies of the response shall be provided to the complainant to the extent permitted by law.
